verdict.rationale: The GitHub README documents installing via pip, uv, Docker, or Kubernetes, and the getting-started docs promise going "from zero to your first AI conversation in under five minutes," which covers the self-host install story. Community users confirm running it via Docker but complain about very large Docker images, which can slow the "in minutes" setup. Missing for 10: the exact one-line install command is not quoted in the evidence, and there is no independent hands-on confirmation of the under-five-minutes time-to-chat.
